heading: $ WHOAMI
paragraphs: I'm a Computer Science student at NIT Andhra Pradesh who enjoys building things and understanding how they work under the hood. My main interests are competitive programming, full-stack development, and turning ideas into practical, usable products.

Outside of solving algorithmic problems, I spend my time building web applications, experimenting with new technologies, and participating in hackathons and developer communities. I prefer learning by building — shipping projects, breaking things, and figuring out how to make them better.
